user.title: Connect Spusu UK
user.description: Select an existing IMAP entry configured to provide the Spusu token or login URL in its custom event field. Spusu does not read email bodies. Submitting requests one login email.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Spusu UK
reauth_confirm.description: Check the IMAP token handoff, then submit to request one new login email.

retry.title: Login could not complete
retry.description: Check Spusu connectivity and the IMAP custom event field. Submit to request another login email.

progress.waiting_for_token: Waiting for a fresh Spusu token from IMAP, then validating usage. This can take up to five minutes.

error.invalid_account: Enter a phone number or customer number without spaces.
error.token_timeout: No fresh token arrived within five minutes. Check IMAP sender, subject, and custom event data.
error.invalid_response: Spusu returned an unsupported usage response.
